name: znetwork_register_packet_handler
description: zNetwork::RegisterPacketHandler allocates a dispatch-handler record, appends an owning node to the global dispatch list, increments the list count, and returns the record.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte comparison is not accepted for tier S: 0x48c0a0 has 88 unmasked mismatches after 20 relocation bytes and 2 trimmed VC5 NOPs, with BN size 117 and VC5 size 112. Owner-sized byte acceptance remains blocked by sibling zNetwork dispatch-handler list rows.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48c0a0 validates fastcall packetType in CX, handler in EDX, mode on stack, zNetworkDispatchHandlerRecord allocation and field writes, append to g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListSentinel->prev, count increment, and returning the allocated record.

The native dispatch smoke reaches RegisterPacketHandler three times, verifies matching packet-type dispatch through the appended records, and requires the dispatch-handler sentinel list to preserve registration order.
